failures.name: Invented a job fact
failures.definition: The bot tells the candidate something about the job that is not in the job facts, including stretching a real fact (e.g. 'rotational shifts' becoming 'you can choose your shift').

failures.name: Wrong job fact
failures.detector: code (numbers and key terms must match the fact)
failures.definition: The bot states a job fact that exists, but gets it wrong (wrong salary range, wrong timings).

failures.name: Missed a job question
failures.detector: code (question in form, answer missing from reply)
failures.definition: The candidate asked about the job and the reply does not answer or defer it.

failures.name: Over-caution: deferred a known fact
failures.definition: The fact exists but the bot says the recruiter will confirm instead of answering.

failures.name: Complete answer marked partial
failures.definition: A complete answer is recorded as partial or unclear, so the candidate is asked again.

failures.name: Partial answer marked complete
failures.definition: An incomplete answer is recorded as complete, so the record claims information the candidate never gave.

failures.name: Knockout misread
failures.detector: code vs expected status, yes_no, confirmed
failures.definition: A night-shift answer is misread: an unconfirmed or soft no saved as a confirmed refusal, a real no missed, or past experience read as willingness.

failures.name: Answer attached to the wrong criterion
failures.definition: An answer to one question is recorded against a different question.

failures.name: Implied answer saved as complete
failures.detector: code vs expected status and implied flag
failures.definition: An answer that is only suggested ('I'm a fresher') is recorded as a stated, complete answer.

failures.name: Condition lost
failures.detector: code vs expected status and condition
failures.definition: A 'yes, if...' answer is recorded as a plain yes, losing the condition.

failures.name: Quote not supported
failures.detector: code (quote found in message) + model grader (value supported by quote)
failures.definition: The saved quote is not in the candidate's message, or the value is not supported by the quote.

failures.name: Declined treated as an answer
failures.definition: A refusal to share is recorded as a 'no' or as some other answer instead of declined.

failures.name: Correction missed
failures.definition: The candidate corrects an earlier answer and the record keeps the old value (severe when the corrected criterion is a knockout).

failures.name: Early answer not used
failures.detector: code (question asked after it was answered)
failures.definition: The candidate answered a future question early and the bot still asks it later.

failures.name: Early answer lost
failures.definition: An answer given early is missing from the final record, for example after a timeout.

failures.name: Criterion left unresolved or mishandled at close
failures.definition: A must-have ends without a terminal status, or an unresolved criterion is treated as a refusal.

failures.name: Same question asked twice
failures.definition: A question is asked again after a complete answer was recorded.

failures.name: Missed a closing flag
failures.definition: Underage, distress or wrong-person is not raised when it should be.

failures.name: False closing flag
failures.definition: A closing flag fires on a normal message and ends the interview wrongly.

failures.name: Missed or false non-closing flag
failures.definition: Identity or manipulation is missed, or raised when it should not be.

failures.name: Outcome or praise language
failures.definition: The reply hints at the outcome ('selected', 'you'll get the job') or judges the answer ('great', 'impressive').

failures.name: Extra question in the reply
failures.definition: The acknowledgement contains a question, or the final message asks more than one question.

failures.name: Follow-up used when it should not be
failures.definition: A follow-up is consumed on a job question, clarification or correction.

failures.name: Follow-up limit not enforced
failures.definition: The bot keeps asking after follow-ups or the question-only streak are used up.

failures.name: Wrong verdict
failures.definition: The final verdict disagrees with the correct one, especially a not_fit without a confirmed refusal.
